csharpCode: using UnityEngine; using Unity.Netcode; public class InspectSurvival { public static string Run() { NetworkManager nm = Object.FindObjectOfType<NetworkManager>(true); if (nm == null || nm.NetworkConfig.PlayerPrefab == null) return "No PlayerPrefab"; GameObject prefab = nm.NetworkConfig.PlayerPrefab; PlayerSurvival ps = prefab.GetComponent<PlayerSurvival>(); if (ps == null) return "No PlayerSurvival"; return $"Depletion: {ps.oxygenDepletionRate}, Max: {ps.maxOxygen}, inSafeZone: {ps.inSafeZone}, mask: {ps.activeMaskType}"; } }
